exact_statement: Every finite-dimensional CP Hilbert-Schmidt-selfadjoint map admits a Kraus representation with all Kraus operators Hermitian. If it is unital, then sum_j H_j^2=I and for Hermitian A, <A,(I-Phi)A>_tau = (1/2) sum_j ||[H_j,A]||_{2,tau}^2.
assumptions: Phi completely positive and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint
status: internally proved finite-dimensional structural lemma; not externally reviewed
novelty_boundary: Standard Choi real-structure/Kraus factorization plus direct commutator expansion; does not establish factor-two EB comparison.
costs: Existence representation only; no constructive factorization/runtime or precision bound claimed.
falsifier: A CP HS-selfadjoint map with no Hermitian Kraus factorization, or a direct violation of the displayed Dirichlet identity.
next_gate: Use the supplied symmetric extension to obtain a single POVM whose covariance dominates I minus twice this Dirichlet form.

exact_statement: For a unital CP HS-selfadjoint map Phi with a supplied two-output CPTP extension whose both marginals equal Phi, Fix(Phi) is an abelian *-subalgebra. Under the Hermitian Kraus form it equals {H_j}'. Its trace-preserving conditional expectation is canonical EB.
assumptions: full-domain two-output CPTP extension with equal marginals
status: internally proved via the Dirichlet commutant identity and multiplicative domain of the broadcaster adjoint; not externally reviewed
novelty_boundary: Exact fixed-point classicality only. It does not show approximate fixed spaces have a uniform abelian approximation or yield the universal Dirichlet comparator.
costs: Finite-dimensional existence; no algorithmic or robustness cost claimed.
falsifier: An admissible compatible channel with noncommuting fixed observables.
next_gate: Quantify the relation between low-energy spaces and a single EB covariance without a spectral-gap or frame-rank factor.

exact_statement: The qubit universal 1-to-2 cloner marginal Phi(X)=2X/3+tau(X)I/3 admits no factor-two comparator of the form E_D for a trace-preserving conditional expectation onto any abelian subalgebra D of M_2, although a non-idempotent EB comparator attains factor two.
assumptions: Phi is the universal symmetric cloner marginal
E_D is tau-preserving conditional expectation onto an abelian subalgebra
status: internally proved exact obstruction to projection/conditional-expectation route; not an obstruction to EB comparison
novelty_boundary: Conditional expectations are a strict subclass of EB channels; coherent-state measure-and-prepare map achieves equality for the cloner.
costs: Exact d=2 algebra; no computation or acquisition.
falsifier: An abelian D with a traceless unit A orthogonal to D for which the projection inequality holds; dimension counting rules this out.
next_gate: Any universal proof must allow non-idempotent EB maps, not only conditional expectations.

exact_statement: For the lazy cycle classical channel in equation (4) of MARKOV_FORM_GATE.md, the exact fixed algebra is the scalars, but its fixed-algebra conditional expectation violates I-E_Fix <= 2(I-Phi) for all d>=5; the violating first Fourier mode has ratio 1/[2 sin^2(pi/d)]. The channel itself is EB and is a factor-one comparator.
assumptions: channel dephases input then applies P to diagonal probabilities
status: internally proved exact obstruction to replacing slow modes by the exact fixed-point projection; not a counterexample to the EB target
novelty_boundary: Only refutes fixed-point expectation as a proof strategy; the channel is already EB.
costs: Closed-form finite-dimensional eigenvalues; no numerical computation.
falsifier: The cycle spectral calculation or fixed-algebra identification fails.
next_gate: A comparator must preserve slow classical modes while still suppressing quantum incompatibility.

exact_statement: For canonical POVM EB maps Psi_M, the factor-two operator comparison is equivalent (by finite-dimensional convex separation) to the all-positive-Q support inequality sup_M Tr_HS(Q Psi_M) >= Tr_HS(Q(2Phi-I)); in Hermitian Kraus coordinates its per-observable form is equation (6) of MARKOV_FORM_GATE.md.
assumptions: comparison restricted to canonical selfadjoint EB maps generated by a POVM
novelty_boundary: Canonical EB maps suffice for a positive result; failure for this subclass alone need not refute comparison against all EB channels unless a reduction is proved.
costs: Existential POVM; no outcome, runtime or precision bound.
falsifier: A proof for every Q settles canonical factor two; an exact admissible Q with strict support deficit refutes canonical factor two.
next_gate: Prove or violate the rank-independent one-POVM support inequality using the 2-output extension; existing rank-two/tree arguments leave the general rank open.

exact_statement: If an admissible HS-selfadjoint channel has every nonfixed eigenvalue at most 1/2, then the trace-preserving expectation E_Fix onto its abelian fixed algebra is EB and satisfies I-E_Fix <= 2(I-Phi). More generally its comparison constant is at most gamma^{-1} for gamma=min_{lambda<1}(1-lambda).
assumptions: Phi CP, unital, TP, HS-selfadjoint and self-compatible
spectral gap gamma>0 on Fix(Phi)^perp; for c=2 require gamma>=1/2
novelty_boundary: A gap-restricted consequence only; it does not address arbitrarily slow classical modes or the unrestricted factor-two claim.
costs: Exact finite-dimensional spectral condition; no algorithm/runtime claim.
falsifier: An eigenvector in Fix(Phi)^perp with 1-lambda<gamma, contradicting the defined gap or the displayed order.
next_gate: Avoid assuming a gap by constructing a non-idempotent EB comparator that retains slow modes.

exact_statement: If a trace-preserving EB map Psi satisfies I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi) for unital trace-preserving HS-selfadjoint Phi, then Psi is forced to be unital; (Psi+Psi*)/2 is a self-adjoint bistochastic EB comparator satisfying the same order.
assumptions: operator order on Hermitian HS space
status: internally proved exact reduction of the full EB search set
novelty_boundary: The symmetrized bistochastic EB map need not be a canonical same-effect/same-preparation POVM map; this does not identify the full EB support function with the canonical one.
costs: Finite-dimensional algebraic reduction; no algorithm/runtime claim.
falsifier: A trace-preserving EB Psi satisfying the order but failing Psi(I)=I, or whose adjoint is not EB under the stated bistochastic condition.
next_gate: Either characterize self-adjoint bistochastic EB transfer operators directly, or prove the stronger canonical support gate.
